Ultra-realistic cinematic studio photography inside a dark professional boxing ring, medium full-body shot at eye level. A woman sits exhausted yet tense on a low, worn wooden stool in the corner of the ring between thick ropes. She is slightly slouched forward with her legs crossed at the knees. One elbow rests heavily on the ring rope, her forearm raised with her wrapped fist held near her mouth as if catching her breath, head tilted slightly downward and to the side. Stoic, serious expression, no smile, conveying a raw post-fight mood of strength and fatigue. She has slicked-back damp hair, sharp minimal makeup, and light sheen of sweat on her skin. She is wearing a tightly laced beige satin corset, white cotton boxing hand wraps, and white knee-high athletic socks with bare feet resting on the canvas. Hanging over the corner ropes are a pair of white leather boxing gloves and a white towel. Dramatic, strong directional studio lighting from directly above casts deep, hard shadows across her body and the ring floor, highlighting muscle tension, skin texture, and fabric creases. Dark, moody studio background fading into shadow. Shot on 50mm lens, f/2.8, sharp focus, natural film grain, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, 8k resolution.
